title: Trump rejects Iran’s Strait of Hormuz proposal, Tehran awaits formal response
description: U.S. President Donald Trump has rejected an Iranian proposal aimed at reopening the Strait of Hormuz and restarting negotiations to end the ongoing conflict in the region. The proposal, presented through Qatari mediators during the UN General Assembly in New York, offered to reopen the strategic waterway and resume talks within seven days if Washington met Tehran’s conditions. Trump said the terms were unacceptable, while Iran’s Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said Tehran was still awaiting an official response from Washington and stressed that diplomacy remained the only way forward.

The pursuit came to an end when the police successfully intercepted the fleeing car, leading to the suspects' arrest. However, details about the smuggling operation are still scarce.

title: Parvesh Verma slap row: Man files complaint, police reveal prior FIR against him
description: Delhi Police has received a complaint regarding an alleged incident involving Minister Parvesh Verma. The complaint states that Verma slapped a man during a road inspection in Tilak Nagar. AAP leader Jarnail Singh was present and questioned the quality of the road when the incident occurred. Verma disputes the allegations, claiming the video does not show the full context.

title: LPU row escalates: Stones pelted, vehicles set on fire as police lathicharge students
description: Students at Lovely Professional University protested against unverified claims of a rape on campus, leading to unrest. The protest intensified as students blocked the Jalandhar-Phagwara National Highway, causing significant traffic disruption. Police attempted to resolve the situation but were met with stone-pelting from protesters, resulting in injuries on both sides.

title: Jobless NJ man's free mowing grew into 2,000 volunteers nationwide
description: After losing his job, Brian Schwartz founded a remarkable volunteer initiative named I Want To Mow Your Lawn. This program offers complimentary lawn care services to seniors, veterans, and others in need. Through a digital platform, volunteers across all 50 states now connect with those requiring assistance, resulting in a thriving community of over 2,000 compassionate participants who collectively enhance the spirit of service and support nationwide.

title: Panda-monium: When diplomacy goes to the dogs, horses, and elephants
description: Get ready, Atlanta! Two charming giant pandas, Ping Ping and Fu Shuang, will be gracing the zoo with their presence this Monday, thanks to a decade-long conservation agreement. This unique event reflects the tradition of panda diplomacy, which has played a pivotal role in fostering international friendships. The nuances of this approach reveal essential lessons in both diplomacy and environmental conservation.

title: France steps in to protect Saudi oil infrastructure as Houthi attacks intensify
description: France's military support to Saudi Arabia will involve deploying troops and defense systems to protect key energy infrastructure. The deployment follows repeated Houthi attacks on Saudi oil facilities and aims to secure the Red Sea port of Yanbu. French official Jean-Noel Barrot emphasized that France's role is strictly defensive and does not equate to participation in the conflict.

title: Asian Games: Athletics leads India’s seven-medal haul, three boxers assure medals
description: India showcased a stellar performance at the Asian Games 2026, clinching a total of seven medals, predominantly in athletics and squash. Parul Chaudhary shone brightly, securing a bronze in the women’s 3000m steeplechase. Silver medals were added by Ancy Sojan and Sarvesh Kushare in their respective disciplines. The boxing team also excelled, confirming three medals through successful semifinal performances.

title: Sidney Crosby’s fortune: How the NHL star built his wealth beyond hockey
description: Sidney Crosby’s story is about much more than his NHL salary. The captain of the Pittsburgh Penguins has made more than $150 million in reported contract value over the course of his career, while also building a commercial profile through major brand partnerships. His current contract, long-term endorsements, shareholder position with NORQAIN and property holdings give a wider view of how the hockey icon built his fortune.

title: Gold and silver outlook: Job data, crude and more in focus to guide bullion this week
description: The gold and silver markets are poised for significant fluctuations as crucial US jobs and inflation data are on the horizon. Investors are keenly aware of the Federal Reserve's hints about possible policy adjustments, which could greatly influence precious metals. Additionally, consumer confidence, GDP figures, and inflation metrics from the Eurozone are on the radar.

title: Asian Games: Why India dropped out of top 10 despite winning seven more medals
description: India added seven medals on Day 8 of the Asian Games, including two silver medals in squash and five in athletics. Parul Chaudhary achieved a new national record in the women's 3000m steeplechase, winning bronze. However, India did not win any gold medals, leading to a drop in its overall standings. Boxers Parveen Hooda, Ankush Panghal, and Narender secured medals by reaching the semifinals.

title: Rob Lowe says he was happy after Will Smith slapped Chris Rock at Oscars
description: Rob Lowe has revealed he was “the only person happy” when Will Smith slapped Chris Rock at the 2022 Oscars, hoping the shocking incident would overshadow his infamous 1989 Academy Awards performance. Lowe joked that his decades-old Oscars blunder continues to haunt him, despite Smith’s slap becoming one of Hollywood’s biggest controversies.

$17.1M to restore 206,000 acres, 225 miles for wildlife movement in West
description: The National Fish and Wildlife Foundation has announced $13.3 million in grants for 14 projects across the western US. With $3.8 million in matching contributions, the conservation work will have a total impact of $17.1 million. The projects will restore habitat, improve migration corridors and modify 225 miles of fencing for wildlife.

title: Who is Sarvesh Kushare? From Hangzhou heartbreak to Asian Games silver in Japan
description: Kushare cleared 2.25m to finish second. Chinese Taipei's Chao-hsuan Fu also cleared 2.25m but won gold, while South Korea's Sanghyeok Woo took bronze with a best effort of 2.22m. He cleared 2.10m, 2.14m, 2.18m, 2.22m and 2.25m before failing to clear 2.28m in all three attempts.

title: Barrier-free tolling: How FASTag & number plates will auto-collect toll
description: With barrier-free tolling, vehicles can move through at normal highway speeds while cameras and FASTag systems identify the vehicle and collect the toll automatically.

description: Patrick Mahomes, the Kansas City Chiefs’ popular quarterback, has weighed in on the team's performance as he gears up to face the Miami Dolphins.

title: Chess Olympiad: Savitha heroics bring medal; Arjun helps India bag Open silver
description: India secured a memorable double podium at the Chess Olympiad in Samarkand. Savitha Shri’s resilient 83-move draw sealed bronze for the women, while Arjun Erigaisi’s dramatic late victory helped the open team win silver on tiebreak. Uzbekistan took open gold and China won women’s gold. India also claimed the Gaprindashvili Cup for the best combined performance.

title: Asian Games: Tejaswin Shankar wins decathlon bronze after 1500m triumph
description: In an impressive display of athleticism, Tejaswin Shankar clinched the decathlon bronze medal at the Asian Games by triumphing in the 1500m race. With a remarkable total of 7,934 points, he secured a podium position, while Japan's Yuma Maruyama took the gold. Meanwhile, Ancy Sojan finished just shy of gold in the women's long jump, placing second behind China's Yingying Huang.

title: ‘Hurled abuses at my family’: Delhi minister reveals ‘truth’ behind viral slap video
description: During a recent road inspection in Tilak Nagar, Delhi's PWD Minister Parvesh Verma faced backlash after a video emerged of him allegedly slapping a local youth. Verma stated that he acted in response to an insult aimed at his family from the youth's associate. Additionally, he accused local MLA Jarnail Singh of trying to extract commissions from roadwork contracts. Following the incident, Verma's engineer has filed an FIR.

title: New homes, new jobs: Why this Denver-area ZIP code is drawing movers
description: Aurora, Colorado's 80019 ZIP code is now the most popular destination for movers in the United States. The ranking is based on a significant number of new housing developments in the area. Fort Leavenworth, Kansas, remains in second place due to military relocations that dominate its movement figures. Florida has three spots in the top ten, appealing to retirees and remote workers.

title: NEET leak fallout: CISF to guard NTA’s confidential exam areas
description: Responding to the alarming issue of exam paper leaks, the National Testing Agency has fortified its security protocols. A dedicated team of 29 CISF personnel is now assigned to the agency's new office for rigorous oversight. In addition to advancing cybersecurity measures, the NTA is revisiting its entire examination-cycle systems to thwart unauthorized access. Independent audits will also be conducted, aiming for a significant improvement in examination integrity moving forward.

title: Tamil Nadu govt rolls back law and order department’s RTI exemption amid backlash
description: The Tamil Nadu government faced backlash after it issued a notification that exempted the Public (Law and Order) Department from the Right to Information (RTI) Act. Critics, including numerous political leaders, argued that such an action would jeopardize transparency and obstruct public access to crucial law records. In response to widespread criticism, the government promptly withdrew the exemption, reaffirming its commitment to uphold the RTI Act.

title: Asian Games: Ancy Sojan misses gold by 2cm, Shaili loses bronze on final jump
description: In a nail-biting finish at the Asian Games 2026, Ancy Sojan just fell short of clinching the gold medal in the women's long jump, achieving a stellar jump of 6.53m, only to be bested by China's Yingying Huang at 6.55m. Shaili Singh, meanwhile, faced disappointment, slipping to fourth place with a last jump that pushed her down after Mengyi Tan's leap.

RAF Fairford alert: Several arrested, homes evacuated near US air base - key details
description: Several men were arrested near RAF Fairford on suspicion of violations under the Explosives Act. Residents of the nearby village of Whelford were evacuated to a leisure center in Cirencester. Police established a cordon around the area while an Army explosive ordnance disposal team assessed several vehicles. Counter-terrorism police are leading the investigation but have not confirmed a link to RAF Fairford.

title: New mobile recharge rules: 30-day plans, call-only options and more
description: The Telecom Regulatory Authority of India has unveiled enhancements to prepaid mobile recharge options, featuring more voice-and-SMS-only Special Tariff Vouchers. Users can now access plans with a validity of 30 days or less. This initiative is especially beneficial for senior citizens and budget-conscious individuals who prefer voice-only prepaid plans without data, addressing concerns raised by Rajya Sabha MP Raghav Chadha.

title: Kashmera backs Sunita Ahuja: Actor questions Komal Rani’s affair claims
description: Kashmera Shah defended Sunita Ahuja after Komal Rani's cryptic Instagram note, calling it the first time women in their family were labelled "murderers" for protecting loved ones. Komal Rani questioned Sunita's intentions without naming her. The controversy follows affair rumours between Govinda and Komal Rani, his 'Roopa' co-star, since earlier this year.

title: 'We trusted EC in 2017': Akhilesh alleges poll officials deleted SP votes in 2022
description: Akhilesh Yadav has accused the Election Commission of deliberately deleting votes belonging to the Samajwadi Party. He argues that this malpractice has been ongoing for years but is only now gaining attention. In his statement, he noted that voters from the 2019 elections were unjustly denied the opportunity to vote in 2022. This controversy follows recent revelations about objections within the Election Commission regarding the electoral rolls revision.

title: When ‘secret spot’ goes viral: The tourism trap of too many views, too many visitors
'Oye maar kaise raha hai': On cam, Delhi minister Parvesh Verma slaps man
description: Captured on video during a road inspection in Tilak Nagar, Delhi, PWD Minister Parvesh Verma's unexpected slap to a young man has stirred controversy. Released by the Aam Aadmi Party, the footage shows Verma confronting the individual before a security guard intervenes. This incident has ignited debate regarding the behavior of public servants in the line of duty, attracting the attention of numerous onlookers.

title: ‘If Ashutosh not released, I will go to Assam’: CJP's Dipke warns Himanta
description: Abhijeet Dipke, spokesperson for the Cockroach Janta Party, has voiced strong concerns regarding the detention of Ashutosh Ranka by Assam Police right before a crucial meeting in Guwahati organized to rally volunteers. The circumstances surrounding Ranka's arrest remain ambiguous, causing confusion among party leaders.

title: 'Didn't collect ID': Guwahati homestay where student, ‘lover’ stayed 5 times sealed
description: Nimisha Thakuria's death has prompted police to seal Rudra’s Kitchen homestay at Dharapur. Investigators are examining guest documentation and prior visits made by her and Ashiq Ali. Police indicated that Ali's claim of suicide has not yet been confirmed. The circumstances surrounding Nimisha's unconscious state and subsequent death are being explored. Authorities are investigating all possible angles related to the case.

title: New Green Card rules from September: Categories affected and those exempt
description: Beginning in September 2026, the USCIS unveiled new regulations affecting Green Card seekers. These guidelines emphasize the financial self-sufficiency of applicants while excluding those in humanitarian categories. Nearly all applicants, including family and various occupational groups, must satisfy these criteria. While the Form I-864, Affidavit of Support, is crucial, it cannot guarantee approval on its own.

title: Lake 227 algae blooms continued decades after nitrogen was removed
'Giving back to my country': Dubai teen uses birthday savings to build solar plant in UP
description: Vehaan Subramanian, an 18-year-old from Dubai, created a water treatment plant in Uttar Pradesh. The project, named ARUNA, treats arsenic-contaminated groundwater for local communities. Funding was primarily sourced from his personal savings and a reading club he managed. Residents were trained to operate and maintain the facility for sustainable access to clean water. This initiative exemplifies the collaborative efforts between local government and citizens addressing critical water quality issues.

title: IIT-B student suicide: What law says about abetment, instigation and ‘guilty mind’
description: The heartbreaking suicide of a second-year IIT-Bombay student has ignited debates over complex legal matters concerning abetment. Professor Suryanarayana Doolla finds himself charged with abetting the tragedy, drawing emotional protests from the victim's family. The rarity of successful prosecutions in such cases poses additional challenges, as the Supreme Court insists on clear evidence of intentional instigation.

title: Florida used robot rabbits to hunt Burmese pythons threatening the Everglades
description: Florida is testing solar-powered robot rabbits to help locate invasive Burmese pythons in the Everglades. Developed by the South Florida Water Management District and University of Florida, the robotic decoys mimic prey using heat and scent while AI cameras detect approaching snakes. Officials can then alert trained removal agents, adding technology to Florida’s wider python control efforts.
